limitations.message: This is the compiler's checked purity classification. A false value means not proven pure; individual effects, transitive effects and dynamic targets are not enumerated.

Observations describe the enclosing checked function's prepared syntax. Guards contribute no coverage; null verdicts and conflicting inference contexts remain unknown. This is not a proof of all control-flow paths or a source edit.
